AUTHOR: Baletaud
TITLE: Automatic detection, identification and counting of deep-water snappers on underwater baited video using deep learning
REGION: New Caledonia EEZ (11 seamount summits, 4 deep island slopes), South Pacific
SPECIES: 11 deep-water Lutjanidae (e.g., Pristipomoides filamentosus, P. flavipinnis, Etelis coruscans, Aphareus rutilans, Aprion virescens)
DATA: Own BRUVS footage: 121 deployments (GoPro Hero 4, 4 campaigns 2019-2020), 410 clips of 15 s, 6,364 images, 12,100 annotations
V_EV: Sec. 2.1: 'Sample depths varied between 47 and 552 m'; 'Cameras were set... at 1200 lumens, 120-degree angle led light (Groupbinc).'
D2: 80/20 by annotations, split by individual BRUVS (5,031 train images / 1,333 test images)
D_EV: Sec. 2.1: 'Splitting considered individual BRUVS to avoid images of the same species and BRUVS in the training and testing dataset'
R_EV: Discussion: 'while our study relied on a dataset restricted to New Caledonia, the sampling occurred across the spatially immense EEZ'
C_EV: Sec. 2.3: 'All images where the faster R-CNN detected deep water snappers were reviewed and manually corrected by an expert biologist. This process eliminated false positives'; Results: '1786 were true positives (76%) so 565 were false positives'
E_EV: Results: 'Pearson Correlation coefficient ranged between 0.72 and 0.90 among species... an overall value of 0.85 when combining data from all species.'
ARCH: Faster R-CNN Inception-ResNet V2 (TensorFlow 2 Object Detection API)
METR: Recall, precision, F-measure per species; Pearson r, R2, slope/intercept tests of MaxNAuto/MaxNSemi vs MaxNMan
NOTE: Split by BRUVS deployment (video-level) with explicit leakage rationale; overlapping clips filtered to avoid duplicate images (D3 Y). All from one New Caledonia programme (4 campaigns 2019-2020 pooled) -> R1 N under P2. MaxN comparison is per frame within the test set vs manual annotations of the same frames. C5: expert verification of all test-set detections with FP count reported (semi-automatic protocol); no confidence threshold stated, so C1 NR -> C_ALL P. V: depth and artificial LED lighting reported; discussion notes photic vs aphotic seamounts but no performance stratified by depth/light. Data: 'further inquiries can be directed to' corresponding author.
